plain: Ranking instructions by who sent them, so lower-ranked text can only add to, not overturn, higher-ranked instructions.
eli5: Every note gets read, but a note from the head teacher counts more than a note from a stranger.
technical: A ranking of instruction sources plus a conflict rule, introduced by Wallace et al. (2024): follow lower-ranked instructions that are aligned with higher-ranked ones and ignore misaligned ones, which treats prompt injection, jailbreaks and system-prompt extraction as one problem of a model treating all text as equally privileged.
